shortDescription: Information module for Wireless Accesspoint Configuration Summary

options.name: apMode
options.description: ApMode query parameter. AP Mode. Allowed values are Local, Bridge, Monitor, FlexConnect, Sniffer, Rogue Detector, SE-Connect, Flex+Bridge, Sensor.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: key
options.description: Key query parameter. The ethernet MAC address of Access point.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. The default is 500 if not specified. The maximum allowed limit is 500.

options.name: meshRole
options.description: MeshRole query parameter. Mesh Role. Allowed values are RAP or MAP.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: provisioned
options.description: Provisioned query parameter. Indicate whether AP provisioned or not. Allowed values are True or False.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: wlcIpAddress
options.description: WlcIpAddress query parameter. WLC IP Address.
